title: Allegro
identity: A retailer identifies Václav Nelhýbel’s Allegro as a 10-page BMC382 edition for E-flat alto saxophone and piano. The Royal Conservatory of Music’s 2016 syllabus includes Allegro as an optional work in Grade 8 alto saxophone repertoire.

evidence.claim: Retailer record identifies the edition and instrumentation.
The Royal Conservatory of Music’s 2016 saxophone syllabus lists Nelhybel’s Allegro as an optional work in Grade 8 alto saxophone repertoire.
evidence.source_name: Royal Conservatory of Music, Saxophone Syllabus, 2016 edition, Grade 8

review_focus: Inspect the edition for range, articulation, technical demands, and piano writing.
gaps: The 2016 RCM syllabus provides a Grade 8 repertoire placement but no individual difficulty commentary. No readable score preview or verified recording was found.

searches.query: Vaclav Nelhybel Allegro BMC382 saxophone piano score
searches.checked: Search found RCM syllabus Grade 8 entry and catalog metadata; no composer or current publisher page matching BMC382 found.
Exact-title searches returned other Nelhybel works and unrelated Allegros; no verified performance recording of this edition found.
Publisher preview search returned no BMC382 score sample; retailer metadata remains the edition source.
